name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=run_chapter_intro_menu, descriptor=typeB). The 'typeB' suffix is a real variant designator, not address residue: this is one of three sibling orchestrators (_main @ 0x2E341, _typeB @ 0x2FC85, _typeC @ 0x3072F) selected by the caller fd2_chapter_transition_with_intro on data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (0/others -> _main, 3 -> _main with FDOTHER 0x1D, 4 -> _typeC, 0 -> _typeB). Name accurately reflects 'the between-chapters intro menu used for non-shop/battle-only chapters'. No hex address tail.
purpose: Chapter-intro menu TYPE B: the between-chapters menu for non-shop (battle-only) chapters (cursor_state == 0), offering Status / Save / Load / Begin-battle; returns 1 when the player confirms starting the battle, else 0.
logic_summary: Reads the chapter-meta category byte for the current chapter (used later by the pose-out animation index), loads the fixed FDOTHER BG atlas (idx 0x0D), fades it in, paints the speaker portrait (portrait_id_table[0]) and shows greeting dialog 0x249. Main loop: restore saved cursor, play open animation, run the shared 4-way fd2_chapter_intro_menu_input_loop, save cursor on commit, play outro animation, unconditionally slide-close the dialog. On commit, dispatch by data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx: 0=fd2_run_status_screen_member_menu, 1=fd2_save_current_state_to_slot(1), 2=fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot, 3='begin battle?' sub-prompt (portrait[0] + dialog 0x19F, run typewriter loop + page-advance collapse; if typewriter != -1 AND confirm cursor==0(yes) show 'battle starting' dialog 0x1A0, delay, slide-close and return 1). After a non-battle action, re-show greeting 0x24A; loop while input committed (1), cancel(-1) exits. Exit path: blit BG, fade to black, 11-frame (iVar5 10..0) nearest-neighbour pose-out scaling snapshot_buf via fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose (src_cx from y-row table -0x96 +0x5000, src_cy from x-column table -100 +0x3200, both scaled iVar5/10*0x80; pose index = cursor_state + chapter_meta_byte*6), commit each frame from the large game-state buffer, ramp brightness; then free the BG atlas and return 0.

params.name: snapshot_buf
params.semantics: Heap pointer to the caller's previously-allocated 64000-byte backdrop VGA snapshot (caller does pose_bitmap = malloc(64000); memmove(pose_bitmap, 0xA0000, 64000)). Used as the source bitmap for the exit pose-out scaled-blit animation (fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose). Owned/freed by the caller, not by this function.
params.reason: Accurate and descriptive of the actual value passed (the saved framebuffer snapshot fed to the pose-out animation). No param_1 placeholder, no address residue. Sibling functions name the analogous arg 'pose_bitmap'; either is acceptable and no rename is required here.

returns.semantics: 1 when the player confirms starting the battle (cursor 3 -> 'begin battle?' -> yes, i.e. typewriter result != -1 AND confirm cursor == 0); 0 otherwise (any other exit, including cancel out of the menu).
